summary: Lixiang Education Holding Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing it regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum market value of publicly held shares requirement (MVPHS ≥ US$5 million). The Nasdaq Staff notified the Company on June 5, 2026 that, after ten consecutive business days (May 21–June 4, 2026), the MVPHS condition was met, closing the matter from the February 9, 2026 deficiency notice. No transaction, shareholder vote, or advisor is involved. This is a routine listing-compliance update, not a special situation. What to watch: continued compliance with Nasdaq continued-listing standards.
